statement.p: (a) What is the average value of f(x) on the interval from x = 0 to x = 2?
(b) If f(x) is even, find each of the following:
the average of f(x) on the interval x = -2 to x = 2 =
(c) If f(x) is odd, find each of the following:
the average of f(x) on the interval x = -2 to x = 2 =

static.solution:
(a) The average value of f(x) on the interval is given by {1\over {2 - 0}}\,\int_{0}^{2}\,f(x)\,dx = 3.
(b) If f(x) is even, then \int_{-2}^{0}\,f(x)\,dx = \int_0^{2}\,f(x)\,dx = 6. Thus \int_{-2}^{2}\,f(x)\,dx = 12, and the average value is accordingly \hbox{avg} = {1\over (2 - (-2))} (6 + 6) = 3.
(c) If f(x) is odd, then \int_{-2}^{0}\,f(x)\,dx = -\int_0^{2}\,f(x)\,dx = 6. Thus \int_{-2}^{2}\,f(x)\,dx = 0, and the average value is therefore also zero.
